The Al Muwashsha Collection

Craft & Materials

Materials chosen for their singularity

01 Selected Walnut

Deep in tone, warm to the touch, with grain that gives every piece its own character. We choose it precisely because its natural variation is part of the object’s value.

02 Natural Mother-of-Pearl Inlay

Every fragment has its own tone, shimmer, and subtle variation. When it catches the light, no two surfaces reveal themselves in quite the same way.

03 Refined Metal Details

Placed at edges, joints, and points of meeting, these small details give the piece balance, precision, and quiet presence.

04 Silk Interior

Soft and tactile, the silk creates a gentle transition between the solidity of walnut and the delicacy of what it holds.
